Title: Burning Wrath -- How much aggravated damage?

Messages.Author: theoperat0r
Messages.Body:
Hi,

How much damage does Burning Wrath at superior do, assuming it is used with a vampire with the standard 1 strength. IE: Does it do (1 dmg + 2 agg) or (3 agg)?

I believe the following rule would suggest the (1dmg+2agg):

The base damage does not inherit the properties of the additional damage (So a Saturday Night Special with Dragon's Breath Rounds does 1 normal plus 2 aggravated damage). [RTR ]

But others I play with suggest that it would do the 3 agg.

Kindly settle this for us, thank you. (I have search both here and VEKN, but came up with nothing exactly like what I am asking, but if it was somewhere there and I missed it, make a link and I will give you :gg::gg::gg::gg::gg:)

Burning Wrath (combat, 3 blood)
pot: Strike: hand strike at +1 damage, aggravated.
POT: Strike: hand strike at +2 damage, aggravated.

Messages.Author: Rulemonger
Messages.Body:
All damage from Burning Wrath is aggravated.

It does (strength+2) aggravated damage. If your strength is 1, that comes out to 3 agg.

strength is an amount, not a type of damage.
